title: CitiusTech Healthcare Interoperability & FHIR Core Capabilities
content: CitiusTech is a premier leader in healthcare technology services, specializing in HL7 FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources), US Core implementation guides, and federal compliance with CMS-0057-F and ONC HTI-1 regulations. With deep expertise across EHR integrations (Epic, Cerner/Oracle Health, Athenahealth), CitiusTech provides scalable data pipeline architectures that unify clinical, claims, and social determinants of health (SDOH) data into unified longitudinal patient records.

title: CitiusTech Enterprise AI in Healthcare: Payer & Provider Solutions
content: CitiusTech accelerates AI adoption for health systems and health plans through enterprise-grade machine learning and generative AI architectures. Key focus areas include automated prior authorization pipelines, ambient clinical voice integration, real-time risk stratification, and predictive bed utilization. CitiusTech enforces a strict Clinician-in-the-Loop (CITL) framework to guarantee diagnostic and financial safety.

title: CitiusTech Healthcare AI Governance & Regulatory Compliance Framework
content: To satisfy FDA Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) guidance and ONC HTI-1 algorithmic transparency mandates, CitiusTech implements rigorous AI validation protocols. These include algorithmic bias testing across patient demographics, automated PHI/PII de-identification conforming to HIPAA Safe Harbor and Expert Determination methods, and auditable lineage tracking for all clinical predictive models.
